recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future tracker changes the SubstanceDefinition relationship model; separate trackers from the same BR&R meeting should be handled independently.
issue_request: FHIR-25053 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R change request, approved 18-0-0 for R5, to rename SubstanceDefinition.relationship.relationship to SubstanceDefinition.relationship.type because the element represents the relationship type.
initial_application: The rename was applied in historical commit e5ea48daa89f2824fc71a4cb9926cb98f48afe5c, which changed the then-authoritative SubstanceDefinition spreadsheet row from SubstanceDefinition.relationship.relationship to SubstanceDefinition.relationship.type. Later build-source rework and SubstanceDefinition migration carried the renamed element into the current XML StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Active source/fhir.ini entries include the SubstanceDefinition resource, BR&R work group, and approved status, confirming build scope. BR&R Confluence minutes for 2019-11-26 record approval of FHIR-25053 at 18-0-0, matching Jira. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was necessary because source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml already defines SubstanceDefinition.relationship.type and active source searches found no stale SubstanceDefinition.relationship.relationship reference.
